title: listening_socket v1
description: One socket accepting connections from outside the machine (loopback is left out): TCP in LISTEN, or UDP bound without a peer. What service it is, and whether it encrypts, is the engine's decision. Emitted before the listening_snapshot of the same run_id. Field names avoid the objects of the Wazuh alerts template (data.port, data.process).

local_address.description: Local address as bound: 0.0.0.0 or :: is every address of the machine (listening_snapshot.addresses).

process_id.description: Process holding the socket; absent when no process could be matched (not root).

unit.description: systemd unit of the process (from its cgroup), or the service a listening socket unit activates.

unit_enabled.description: systemctl is-enabled of unit, as printed (enabled, disabled, static, masked...).

socket_unit.description: systemd socket unit listening on this address (socket activation), when there is one.
